decision.observation: After the reverse the car sits at 0 mph in gear R on a grassy clearing, with all dots dark and no warning icon; its beam points up at a narrow gap between two pines, and the blue road with puddles lies along the right of the frame, beyond a large trunk.
decision.hypothesis: The reverse rotated the car free of the snag. Driving forward with a short right steer should pass through the gap and mount the tarmac beyond it, as long as it does not clip the big pine on the front-right.
decision.memory: Reverse-steer did free the car, but it left the nose facing a tree gap rather than the road. Short inputs rather than full holds keep the car from burying itself between trunks.
